chapter: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
topic: Force on a moving charge in uniform magnetic and electric fields
source_refs: J-PDF p.5 Physics U13; A-PDF p.15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.6 Physics U13
required_variants: Positive/negative charge; parallel/perpendicular v,B; electric force too
acceptance_tests: Check q(E+v×B), zero parallel magnetic force and units; page-normal glyph is not a planar path

chapter: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
source_refs: J-PDF p.5 Physics U13; A-PDF p.15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.6 Physics U13
required_variants: Crossed E,B; selected positive/negative charge beam
acceptance_tests: Check E+v×B=0 and v=E/B only for perpendicular crossed fields; direction-reversed force balance rejects

chapter: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
topic: Circular motion in a magnetic field and the cyclotron
source_refs: J-PDF p.5 Physics U13; A-PDF p.15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.6 Physics U13
required_variants: Circular orbit and cyclotron alternating-gap accelerator
acceptance_tests: Check radius=mv/(abs(q)B), period and gap polarity; circular force is an application, named cyclotron is unlisted and mixed scope needs review

chapter: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
topic: Helical path of a charge in a magnetic field
source_refs: J-PDF p.5 Physics U13; A-PDF p.15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.6 Physics U13
required_variants: Parallel/perpendicular velocity components; pitch and handedness
acceptance_tests: Check radius, cyclotron period and pitch=vparallelT in world coordinates; 2D projection alone cannot certify a helix

chapter: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
topic: Force on a current-carrying conductor in a uniform magnetic field
source_refs: J-PDF p.5 Physics U13; A-PDF p.15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.6 Physics U13
required_variants: Straight conductor parallel/oblique to B; signed current direction
acceptance_tests: Check F=I L×B and distributed cancellation where supplied; a conductor path is not an arbitrary force arrow

chapter: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
topic: Force between two parallel current-carrying conductors
source_refs: J-PDF p.5 Physics U13; A-PDF p.15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.6 Physics U13
required_variants: Equal/opposite parallel currents; unequal currents and separation
acceptance_tests: Verify force/length=μ0I1I2/(2πd) and attraction/repulsion; wire identities and reciprocal forces remain distinct

chapter: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
source_refs: J-PDF p.5 Physics U13; A-PDF p.15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.6 Physics U13
required_variants: Historical force-based ampere definition versus current SI definition
acceptance_tests: Verify stated historical conditions and contemporary constant-defined SI distinction; definition recall needs no invented wire diagram

chapter: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
topic: Torque experienced by a current loop in a uniform magnetic field
source_refs: J-PDF p.5 Physics U13; A-PDF p.15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.6 Physics U13
required_variants: Loop normal, field and angle; arbitrary source-defined area
acceptance_tests: Check τ=m×B with m=NIA n; a projected loop area cannot certify world area

chapter: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
topic: Current loop as a magnetic dipole and its magnetic dipole moment
source_refs: J-PDF p.5 Physics U13; A-PDF p.15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.6 Physics U13
required_variants: Loop turns, oriented area and current reversal
acceptance_tests: Check m=NIA n and orientation; torque magnitude cannot substitute dipole-moment units

chapter: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
topic: Magnetic moment of a revolving charge
source_refs: J-PDF p.5 Physics U13; A-PDF p.15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.6 Physics U13
required_variants: Charge orbit direction and orbital period
acceptance_tests: Check I=q/T and m=IA with charge sign; angular momentum proportionality needs the declared particle model

chapter: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
topic: Moving coil galvanometer and its sensitivity
source_refs: J-PDF p.5 Physics U13; A-PDF p.15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.6 Physics U13
required_variants: Coil, spring and radial field; current/voltage sensitivity
acceptance_tests: Check NBAI=κθ and sensitivity units under stated linear model; missing torsion constant cannot be invented
dependencies: S0; S1; S3; S5; CH-02a; CH-05b

chapter: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
topic: Conversion of a galvanometer to an ammeter and a voltmeter
source_refs: J-PDF p.5 Physics U13; A-PDF p.15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.6 Physics U13
required_variants: Shunt parallel with galvanometer; series multiplier for voltmeter
acceptance_tests: Independently derive shunt/multiplier values and terminal topology; swapped conversion connections reject
dependencies: S0; S1; S3; S5; CH-02a; CH-05b

chapter: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
topic: Torque on a magnetic dipole in a uniform magnetic field
source_refs: J-PDF p.5 Physics U13; A-PDF p.15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.6 Physics U13
required_variants: Current-loop or bar-magnet dipole; parallel/antiparallel field
acceptance_tests: Check m×B and -m·B with supplied moment; Advanced application uses the current-loop model, not a new bar-magnet heading
dependencies: S0; S1; S3; S5; CH-02a; CH-05b
